user.title: Connect to SRP
user.description: Sign in with the same details you use at myaccount.srpnet.com. Your account number is printed on your bill.

data_description.account_id: Nine digits, with or without dashes.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SRP again
reauth_confirm.description: SRP rejected the saved sign-in for account {account}, so polling has stopped. Enter the username and password that work at myaccount.srpnet.com and the sensors will start updating again. The account number stays the same.

data_description.password: SRP does not say which of the two was wrong, so both are asked for.

error.invalid_account: The account number should be nine digits.
error.invalid_auth: SRP rejected that username and password.
error.access_blocked: SRP's bot protection refused the request. Your credentials are probably fine — this varies by network and usually clears on its own. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: That account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. Polling has resumed and the sensors will refresh shortly.
